description: Generates personalized follow-up emails, appointment reminders, post-visit surveys, and care instructions with Gmail integration

email_content.subject: We Care About Your Recovery – Follow-Up from Your Recent Visit
email_content.body:
Dear Patient,

We hope this message finds you well. We wanted to follow up regarding your recent visit at our hospital. Your health and comfort are our top priorities, and we are here to support you as you continue your recovery.

If you have any new symptoms, concerns, or questions about your care plan, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. Our team is ready to assist you in any way we can.

Thank you for trusting us with your healthcare needs. Wishing you a smooth and speedy recovery!

Best regards,
Your Care Team
